# claude.md — Register Errands - Dynamic (tree 595124299) ## Purpose ETG (eTraveli Group) agent workflow, embedded in Zendesk. For a cancellation contact, the agent looks up the Edvin order, selects PNRs/passengers/channel/type, picks a customer action per PNR, and the tree auto-creates the Zendesk child/silent/grandchild tickets, registers the errand in Edvin, and posts an internal note. ## Architecture (flow) Root = 10 (Clear session and start fresh order -> continues to 4). Per-PNR intake loop: 10 Clear session (root) -> 4 Find Order -> 6 Select PNRs -> 24 Set order context & channel -> 7 Set Selected PNRs -> 8 Select Passengers -> 9 Format Passengers -> 42 GET Edvin Errands (API) -> 46 Format Types (sets transforms.channel/category OBJECTS) -> 1 Select Channel & Type -> 2 Build actions_array + push PNR -> 54 Select Customer Action (NATIVE dynamic select, v26) -> 55 Record Customer Action -> 11 More PNRs? (loop to 7, else 12 REVIEW table). DRIFT NOTE (2026-08-05): the intake line above still describes v26's nodes 54/55 (NATIVE dynamic select + Record Customer Action). Neither node exists in the current export - the flow goes 2 -> 11 -> 12 -> 25. Left as-is rather than rewritten from guesswork; correct it in the session that next touches intake. Then: 12 Create PNR Action Table -> 25 Display table -> 27 Stitch & Group + build child tickets -> 50 GUARD: any unusable action selections? -> [51 Re-pick screen -> back to 12] else -> 3 GUARD: any child tickets? -> (32 child-ticket cursor loop: 32->33 Create Child Ticket->35 Grand children?-> [39 Set Side Conversation Parent Id (resets resolve-chain flags) -> UNROLLED 3-attempt resolve chain, v37, no node repeated: 41 wait->40 fetch->18 check(1/3)->19 router{resolved:36 | else:20} -> 20 wait->26 fetch->28 check(2/3)->30 router{resolved:36 | else:31} -> 31 wait->54 fetch->55 check(3/3 FINAL, sets blocked if still unresolved)->56 router{resolved:36 | blocked:34}] ->37->38 grandchild loop (38 loops back to 36 for the next grandchild, exits to 34) ->34 More child tickets?-> loop 32) else-> 21 Format Internal Note -> 22 Add Internal Note -> 44 register-errands loop (44->17 Errand already registered?->43 Register Errand->45 More errands?) -> 23 Closing Call -> [47 Additional request | 49 Different request | 48 End Session] -> 29 Clear Data -> back to 4. CORRECTION (v43, 2026-08-27): the "50 GUARD: any unusable action selections? -> [51 Re-pick screen -> back to 12]" clause above is STALE - it predates v42's node-numbering reuse. Nodes 50/51 are now the Get/Update Grandchild Ticket Details status-check pair (see the v42 section below); they have not gated customer-action selections since before this file's v42 pass, and nothing currently routed on transforms.has_unresolved_selections until this session (see v43 section below). Do not trust the child-ticket resolve-chain node numbers later in that same sentence (41,40,18,19,20,26,28,30,31,54,55,56) either - they also predate v42's numbering and are unverified against the current export. The full Architecture line needs a proper rewrite; out of scope for this session, flagged here so it isn't mistaken for current. ## Data dictionary - transforms.channel / transforms.category: full Edvin errand-config OBJECTS {id,name,categories}. Set in node 46. Store only .name on PNR items (see node 2). - transforms.customer_action_pnrs: array of PNR items {pnr, channel(name), channelId, category(name), categoryId, type, typeId, notes, actions_array}. Built in node 2, restitched in node 27. - actions_array item: {id, name, bucket(STRING), actionId, ...}. bucket normalized to a string in node 2 (bucketKey). - transforms.child_tickets: [{child_ticket:{...grandchild_tickets:[]}}]. Built node 27 by grouping stitched PNRs on the DISTINCT (type+action) key: proceed -> ONE active child (grandchildren = one per distinct type+action, only when 2+ combos); non-proceed -> ONE silent ticket per distinct (type+action). Consumed node 32 loop. - transforms.child_ticket_html (v41, undocumented until now): the agent-facing card rendered by node 84 (Content, `${transforms.child_ticket_html}`). Built in node 32 by buildErrandCardHtml(), which reads .title/.pnr/.bucket/.customer_action/.type/ .formatted_passengers/.passengers off its payload argument - that shape belongs to transforms.current_child_ticket (= child_tickets[cursor].child_ticket, set earlier in node 32), NOT the local `child_ticket` object node 32 also builds a few lines later for node 33's Zendesk create call (subject/body/orderReference/target_ticket_id only - no pnr/passengers). Passing the wrong one is exactly what produced a blank "PNR " title and "No passenger details available" on every card - see changelog. - transforms.final_pnrs: one entry per distinct (type+action). Built node 27 (deduped), consumed ONLY by node 44 (registers one Edvin errand each). v19: node 21 no longer reads it - the internal note reads transforms.customer_action_pnrs so every PNR appears, even when two PNRs share the same type AND action (ZD 7621694). FIXED 2026-08-21 (ZD 337619): each final_pnrs entry used to spread group[0] alone, so an errand covering 2+ PNRs silently dropped every PNR after the first from the Edvin message. buildFinalErrandRecord() (node 27) now combines the whole group - pnr becomes the joined PNR list (joinPnrs), passengers/formatted_passengers are unioned and de-duped, orderReference is the de-duped set joined - before node 44 formats it. FIXED 2026-08-21's pass missed .notes - it stayed on the group[0] spread, so a second PNR's agent notes were dropped from the Edvin "Agent Notes" line whenever 2+ PNRs collapsed into one errand. FIXED 2026-08-24: mergeNotes(group) now builds notes as "PNR: note | PNR: note" (non-empty, de-duped) before node 44 formats it. See changelog. - transforms.unresolved_selections: [{pnr, field, raw, reason, reason_text, bucket, type}] - every PNR whose selection could not be turned into (action + known bucket). Built node 27, rendered by node 27 into transforms.unresolved_note_html for node 51, counted by node 21's log. - has_unresolved_selections / unresolved_selections_count (FORM data): node 50's routing boolean and its count. Form data because logic-node expressions read scalars by name. - transforms.attempted_child_ticket_keys / attempted_grandchild_ticket_keys (v35): the titles this session has ATTEMPTED to create. Recorded by nodes 32 and 36 BEFORE the create fires; read by those same nodes as the duplicate guard that nodes 13/15 route on. These - not the created_* lists - are what stop a duplicate ticket. - transforms.created_child_ticket_keys / created_grandchild_ticket_keys: titles Zendesk CONFIRMED (nodes 14/16, 2xx only). RECONCILIATION INPUT ONLY since v35 - node 21 compares them against planned_ticket_titles to warn about a ticket it cannot prove exists. Do not route a duplicate guard off these again; see Conventions. - transforms.registered_errand_keys (v35): one entry per (type|customer_action) already sent to Edvin this session. Recorded by node 44 before node 43 fires; node 17 routes on it. Deliberately NOT cleared by node 27, so a Back-nav replay cannot re-register an errand Edvin already holds, while a selection the agent genuinely changed makes a new key and registers normally. - skip_errand_registration (FORM data, v35): node 17's routing boolean. True when this errand's key is already registered, or when the cursor has no item at all. - transforms.planned_ticket_titles: every child/silent/grandchild title this run intends to create. Built node 27, compared in node 21 against created_child_ticket_keys + created_grandchild_ticket_keys so the note cannot promise a ticket Zendesk never confirmed. - grandchild_parent_resolved / grandchild_parent_blocked (FORM data, v36, restructured v37): routing booleans set by whichever check node in the resolve chain last ran (18, 28, or 55) and tested by that attempt's router (19, 30, or 56). resolved=true means targetTicketId was proven this pass (grandchild_parent_id now holds it); blocked=true is set ONLY by node 55, the final attempt, when resolution never happened across all 3 tries. Mutually exclusive by construction; reset per child ticket by node 39, and by nodes 10/29 between sessions. v37 DROPPED child_ticket_resolve_attempts (v36's poll counter) - which attempt is running is now which node you are at (18=1st, 28=2nd, 55=3rd/final), not runtime state. See Conventions "GRANDCHILD-PARENT RESOLVE CHAIN" for why. - transforms.blocked_grandchild_parent_keys / blocked_grandchild_ticket_titles (v36): written by node 55 (the final resolve-chain attempt) only when all 3 tries came up empty. The first is the child ticket's title (for diagnostics); the second is every grandchild title under it that was NEVER attempted (not pushed to attempted_grandchild_ticket_keys, since node 36 never ran for them). Node 21 prints these as a distinct BLOCKED line, and excludes them from the generic "not confirmed" reconciliation warning so the two states are never conflated. Reset by nodes 10/29. - Counters: child_tickets_count, grandchild_tickets_count (form data, no TTL) and transforms.final_pnrs_count (node 44). All three clamp on entry and reset to 0 when exhausted, so every loop is re-runnable - final_pnrs_count only since v35. - Display counters (FORM data, v43): child_ticket_display_index/child_tickets_total (node 32, read by node 84's "Create Child Ticket X of Y" heading), grandchild_ticket_display_index/grandchild_tickets_total (node 36, node 85's heading), errand_display_index/final_pnrs_total (node 44, node 78's heading). Each is the 1-based position of the item about to be processed THIS pass (cursor value + 1, read before that cursor increments), paired with the loop's total length. Purely presentational - never read by logic nodes or Connected Objects; do not confuse with the *_count cursor variables above, which are 0-based and drive the loop itself. - has_customer_action_selection (FORM data, v43, fixed 2026-08-27): node 58's routing boolean, gating new Scoring node 59 between node 25 and node 27. True only when EVERY row in transforms.customer_action_pnrs has a non-blank customer_action__ (originally .some() - any ONE row - which is the bug the 2026-08-27 correction entry fixed). transforms.missing_customer_action_pnrs (node 58) lists the PNRs still blank, rendered on node 60. Distinct from has_unresolved_selections (node 27, existing) - see the v43 section below. - Counters (form data, no TTL): child_tickets_count, grandchild_tickets_count; booleans is_more_child_tickets, is_grandchild_tickets, is_more_grandchild_tickets, is_more_pnrs, isMorePNR. - actions.edvin__errand_configuration, actions.get_edvin_prop_long_value: Edvin API responses. ## External systems (CX Actions / Connected Objects) Edvin: Find Order (4), GET Edvin Errands (42), Register Errand (43). Zendesk: Update Tags (31), Create Child Ticket (33), Create Grandchild Ticket (37), Get Side Conversations (40), Add Internal Note (22). ## Conventions & gotchas - A DUPLICATE GUARD MUST RECORD THE ATTEMPT, NOT THE CONFIRMATION (v35, learned from ZD 334818). v25 made nodes 14/16 record a title only on a confirmed 2xx, so that a failed create would still be retried and flagged. But the guards read those same lists - so a create Zendesk actually MADE and reported badly stayed unrecorded, and the next pass created a second ticket. The two jobs need two lists: attempted_* for the guard (written before the call), created_* for the note's warning (written after). When in doubt, prefer a note that says "not confirmed - check the ticket list" over a duplicate written against a customer's order. - EVERY CURSOR LOOP CLAMPS ON ENTRY AND RESETS ON EXHAUSTION. Node 44 was the one loop missing both, so after a full pass its cursor sat at final_pnrs.length and a replay read final_pnrs[out-of-range] === undefined - registering a REAL Edvin errand with no type, action or PNR. Nodes 32 and 36 are the reference shape. - This tree is RE-ENTERED ROUTINELY. Node 25 has Back enabled and keep_vars_on_back=1, so Back + Continue re-fires node 27 and everything downstream of it. Any node that writes to Zendesk or Edvin must be idempotent under that replay - test it, don't assume it. walk.mjs (Workflow JSONs/ETG/) walks the real continuation graph and counts the actual create calls; the offline harness stubs them and cannot see this class of bug. - Transforms expire after 1 hour; node 29 Clear Data resets loop state so the outer "Additional request" loop restarts clean. - Node 3 guard (len(transforms.child_tickets) >= 1) MUST stay before node 32 — node 32->33 creates a Zendesk ticket unconditionally, so an empty set has to skip to 21. - BUCKET LABELS vs ROUTING KEYS (v31/v32 - the cause of "bucket is not one Zingtree routes on"). Edvin returns the bucket as an OBJECT {id, name} where `name` is a HUMAN LABEL, not the snake_case key this tree branches on. bucketKey() only extracted that label, so node 27 - which trims and lowercases before testing KNOWN_BUCKETS - accepted "Proceed" (it happens to lowercase into the key) and rejected everything else. VERIFIED against the live errand-configuration response (2026-08-04). Across all three channels and all thirteen categories Edvin uses exactly THREE buckets, ids stable: id 3 "No action" -> no_action id 4 "Proceed" -> proceed id 5 "Different request" -> different_request There is NO "escalate" bucket in Edvin. KNOWN_BUCKETS still lists it; that is harmless (it never occurs) - do not invent a mapping for it. Measured on the real Cancellation category (17 types, 137 action slots): the pre-fix build rejected 88 of 137 - every No action and every Different request. v32 routes all 137, split proceed 49 / no_action 75 / different_request 13. v32 MATCHES ON THE BUCKET ID FIRST (BUCKET_BY_ID). The id is the contract; the label is display text ETG can reword at any time, and a reworded label silently breaks a name-only map. BUCKET_BY_NAME is the fallback for a bucket that arrives as a bare string. An unmapped bucket is returned UNCHANGED, never guessed - node 27 then flags it and stops the run, because guessing no_action for something that might mean Proceed records "the customer declined" against a customer who did not. Node 46 logs "edvin bucket labels seen: [...]" every session. KEEP THE BLOCK IDENTICAL IN NODES 2 AND 46 - both feed node 27; drift means the same action routes two different ways. Verified by realsweep.mjs against edvin_real.json. - bucket routing keys: proceed | no_action | escalate | different_request. As of v24 an unrecognized or blank bucket is NO LONGER a default-to-silent-ticket; it is a problem that halts the run at node 50. - UNUSABLE SELECTIONS NEVER GET RECORDED (v24, the rule that matters most here): a PNR that does not resolve to a real action with a known bucket must not become a ticket or an Edvin errand. "We could not read the selection" and "the customer declined" produce identical output otherwise, and only one of them is safe to write against an order. Node 27 classifies the problem (selection_unreadable | lookup_failed | bucket_missing | bucket_unrecognized), writes EMPTY child_tickets/final_pnrs, and sets has_unresolved_selections; node 50 routes to node 51, which sends the agent back to node 12 to re-pick. Do not "fix" this by restoring the old warning-in-the-note behaviour - the note used to apologize for a fact it had already recorded. - NO

WRAPPER AROUND GENERATED HTML (v24): node 25 renders ${transforms.customer_action_table_html} bare, and node 51 renders ${transforms.unresolved_note_html} bare. The table HTML opens with a
